status: AN1 results informed proposal; not adopted or implemented in combat

stages.unlock_example: C clear settled at home; both D and E become choices

PS05.effect_proposal: An attack match of the same attribute as the actor's previous own match gains power 2 for that action. Placement does not update previous match; guard and healing matches do. No accumulating stacks. Reset on a new expedition, retain across events.

PS06.effect_proposal: When the actor's own action traverses an environment and exploration continues, recover 3 HP up to max HP. At most once per environmental actor. No trigger on defeat, withdrawal, or terminal clear. No change to cards, posture, rewards, or other persistent state.

limits: The 5 and 6 budgets come from first C-clear totals in frozen AM natural journeys; 8 also comes from new AN repetitions. Other budgets are explanatory fixtures.
Candidate effects and cost 3 are concrete proposals, not simulated effects or product values. Current AN power runs only use PS01-04.
Stage caps 4 and 8 are a comparison option. The first proposal leaves learning uncapped and permits eventual full learning.
The purpose is feasible purchase combinations and refund conservation, not a skill strength score or proof of balance.
